item_short_desc: KIWI Parade Gloss offers a brilliant and durable shine for leather shoes, dress oxfords, and uniform shoes. Its superior multi-wax blend ensures a brighter and longer-lasting shine while repelling water. Made in the USA, this shoe polish contains a unique blend of premium wax and additional carnauba wax. It helps maintain shoes' new appearance for longer compared to untreated shoes.
